items.title: Suspect linked to Monaco bomb attack on millionaire breaks silence to BBC
items.description: Vitalii Zhykovych gives his own account of the attempted assassination of Ukrainian-born businessman Vadym Yermolayev.

items.title: Fort Hood attacker's execution by firing squad will be livestreamed, Pentagon says
items.description: "We'll make sure that people are able to watch it," the US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth said on Thursday.

items.title: Russian strike on buses kills at least 30, say officials, as deadly attacks on Ukraine surge
items.description: Ukraine accused Russia of targeting two crowded vehicles in the front line city of Kramatorsk to kill as many civilians as possible.

items.title: Christa Pike now walking after failed US execution, lawyer tells BBC
items.description: A lawyer says the murderer of Colleen Slemmer is moving around her hospital room after surviving two lethal injections.

items.title: Adidas sues Australian label White Fox over four stripes design
items.description: The German sportswear brand wants the Sydney-based label to stop selling the clothes and pay damages.

items.title: Protesters blame 'vulture funds' for Spain's housing crisis
items.description: Hundreds have pitched their tents in central Madrid, while the Spanish prime minister has called a snap election.

items.title: 'Bold and inventive' Canadian poet Anne Carson wins Nobel Literature Prize
items.description: Carson, 76, is celebrated for works that often cross boundaries between poetry, fiction and scholarship.

items.title: Venezuela's ex-leader Nicolás Maduro charged with conspiracy to commit torture
items.description: The new accusations relate to the alleged torture of US citizens held in Venezuela while Maduro was in power.

items.title: US deportations to African countries unlawful and exploit suffering, rights group says
items.description: More than 500 migrants have been expelled from the US to African countries, HRW says, citing US data.

items.title: Outspoken Indian actor Nana Patekar dies suddenly at 75
items.description: Known for his intense performances, Patekar carved out a distinctive place in Indian cinema.

items.title: Teacher who sexually abused pupil back in Indonesia jail after BBC investigation
items.description: Mochamad Subchi Azal Tsani had been secretly released on parole in 2025, after serving less than half his sentence.

items.title: Italy approves elections overhaul as opposition accuse Meloni of 'scam'
items.description: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni says the move will deliver more stable government, but opposition parties say her aim is to stay in power.
